csv_agency: State of DE Ofc Mgmt & Budget-Div of Facility Mgmt
csv_scope_of_work: Public Notice is hereby given that the State of Delaware, Office of Management and Budget, (OMB), is soliciting letters of interest from professional service firms for the design and preparation of specifications and bid documents and contract administration necessary for Supplemental - Statewide Minor Capital Projects.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Utility Engineering
csv_comments: '- Project Number: OMB26710-SUPMNCAP- Solicitation documents available online.- Questions Deadline: Submit questions online by 07/28/2026 05:00 PM EDT - Multiple Contracts may be Awarded,- Questions Contact & Submit : dfm_ask@delaware.gov
title: AE for As-Needed Statewide Minor Capital Projects
short_description: Statewide on-call design services for minor capital building projects in Delaware.
project_scope: As-needed statewide minor capital projects for the State of Delaware. The notice seeks professional services for design, preparation of specifications and bid documents, and contract administration for supplemental minor capital projects. No specific building, structure type, size, span, floor area, or individual project scope is defined in the notice.
services: Architecture services, interior design/space planning, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, structural engineering, utility engineering; design services, specifications, bid documents, and contract administration.
relevance_explanation:
- Framework-style as-needed services without a defined technical project.
- Focus is general building minor capital projects rather than a specific complex structure.
- Includes structural engineering, but also many non-core disciplines.
- Rehabilitation and refurbishment are mentioned; sbp is generally less interested in such work.
- No indication of long spans, bridges, special structures, sports venues, or architecturally demanding buildings.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated. The notice is for as-needed statewide minor capital projects under multiple possible assignments, with no defined project sizes, quantities, or budgets, so a realistic total construction cost estimate is not possible from the available information.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. This is an on-call professional services solicitation with potentially multiple contracts and undefined future task orders, so no realistic sbp fee estimate can be derived from the notice alone.
references_qualifications: Professional service firms are invited to submit letters of interest for design and contract administration services. Requested disciplines include architecture, interior design/space planning, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil, geotechnical, electrical, mechanical, structural, and utility engineering. No specific minimum reference counts or detailed qualification thresholds are stated in the provided notice.
contracting_authority: State of Delaware, Office of Management and Budget, Division of Facility Management, Dover, DE, USA. Contact: Edwin Robles. Email: edwin.robles@delaware.gov. Phone: 302-739-5644. Questions email: dfm_ask@delaware.gov. Website: https://mmp.delaware.gov/Bids/Details/9245
notes: Project number: OMB26710-SUPMNCAP. Target market: General Building. County: Kent. Multiple contracts may be awarded. Questions deadline: 2026-07-28 05:00 PM EDT. The notice appears to be a statewide on-call/framework procurement rather than a single defined project.
